To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Responsibilities

- Apply Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques to image transformation and defect detection.
- Analyze large-scale image datasets and evaluate algorithm performance.
- Prototype algorithms using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
- Develop production-quality software using Modern C++ and Python.
- Apply best practices in software design, testing, debugging, code reviews, and version control.
- Collaborate with algorithm, software, systems, and application engineers to deploy solutions into production.

Required Qualifications

- Strong background in Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Pattern Recognition.
- Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python.
- Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent ML frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with CNNs, Vision Transformers, or segmentation models.
- Experience with Modern C++ software development.
- Knowledge of image enhancement, image registration, feature extraction, or anomaly detection.
- Experience with large-scale datasets and quantitative algorithm evaluation.

What You'll Gain

- Hands-on experience in AI, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Image Processing, Modern C++, and Software Engineering.
- End-to-end exposure to algorithm development, optimization, and deployment.
- Experience building scalable, production-quality software.
- Mentorship from experts in algorithms, imaging, software engineering, and semiconductor inspection.

Minimum Qualifications

Pursuing a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. The DUV Reticle Stage IBS MDU team is responsible for engineering activities supporting the reticle stage, a precision mechatronic subsystem within ASML’s DUV lithography systems. The reticle stage relies on highly reliable electrical connections that must perform consistently within a demanding precision equipment environment.

We are looking for an Electrical Engineering co-op student to help investigate and qualify alternatives to existing LEMO electrical connectors used on the DUV Reticle Stage. This assignment provides an opportunity to work directly with experienced ASML engineers on a real hardware engineering challenge involving electrical design, component selection, testing, and qualification.

Role and responsibilities

Your primary assignment will be to identify, evaluate, and help qualify alternative electrical connector solutions for the DUV Reticle Stage. Potential solutions may include commercially available connector technologies as well as new or modified connector concepts, but they must ultimately satisfy the relevant performance requirements of the existing solution.

You will work closely with electrical, mechanical, and mechatronics engineers to understand the application, determine critical requirements, investigate potential alternatives, and validate promising solutions through analysis and testing.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Investigate the existing LEMO connector applications and understand their electrical, mechanical, and environmental requirements.
- Work with ASML engineers and subject-matter experts to identify and document critical connector requirements and constraints.
- Research commercially available connector technologies and potential suppliers that could provide viable alternatives.
- Support the development and evaluation of new or modified connector concepts where an off-the-shelf solution is not sufficient.
- Develop a structured method to compare candidate solutions against the existing connector and application requirements.
- Plan and execute engineering tests to characterize promising connector alternatives.
- Analyze test results and identify performance gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
- Collaborate with engineers across disciplines to review findings and determine whether candidate solutions are suitable for further qualification.
- Clearly document requirements, test methods, results, and engineering conclusions so the work can be continued and reused by the engineering team.

This assignment offers the opportunity to take a hardware engineering problem from requirements and concept investigation through hands-on testing and technical recommendation, while gaining experience with the engineering rigor required for components used in complex precision systems.

Job OverviewSouthern Star is currently seeking highly motivated and energetic students or recent graduates to join our team as summer interns. The Enterprise Excellence Intern is exposed to a variety of project-based assignments and will receive mentorship, detailed orientation and training, and valuable work assignments. You will gain meaningful, real-world experience through an analytics project that impacts the Company. The project includes analyzing and interpreting large data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that aid in business decisions. This project will involve designing and developing a data service project using tools like Power BI, R, SQL, Python, AI-assisted analytics tools and Excel. You will work closely with a cross-functional team across the business to implement a data-driven solution that enables a business use case. You can expect to develop confidence and marketable skills including practical experience applying AI tools to real business problems while being mentored by our highly qualified and professional team. Interns will typically support the Enterprise Excellence team in the performance of assignments, spend time shadowing actual business case processes, and have unique assignments that support larger projects as well as experience the day-to-day workings of the department. They may perform and/or participate in additional activities/events which help them build a strong network within the Southern Star community and with fellow interns.

Highlights/Internship Overview: This is a 12-week, competitively paid summer internship starting in May and ending in August. Interns work 40 hours per week with paid company holidays. Responsibilities

- Data Collection and Cleaning: Gather data from various sources and ensure its accuracy and completeness.

- Data Analysis: Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights using statistical methods and tools.

- AI-Enabled Process Improvement: Explore opportunities to apply AI and automation to streamline existing analytics workflows and business process, under the guidance of the Enterprise Excellence team.

- Reporting: Create reports and visualizations to present findings to stakeholders.

- Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions.

- Tool Utilization: Use tools like Excel, SQL, Python, and Tableau for data analysis and visualization.

- Documentation: Document methodologies, processes, and findings for future reference.

- Mentorship: Participate in mentorship sessions with senior team members to gain insights and guidance.

- Communication: Communicate results and insights to stakeholders through presentations, reports, and meetings to ensure understanding and facilitate decision- making.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification

- You must be 18 years of age by the start of the summer internship assignment and maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.75 after each completed semester/term.

- You must be authorized to work in the United States.

- Junior and Senior candidates are on track to graduate with a bachelor’s/master’s degree.

- Majoring in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Experience or willingness to learn data analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, R or Python.

- Ability to contribute to and balance delivery timelines against, multiple projects/demands simultaneously.

License and Insurability

A valid driver’s license and insurability under company policy are required.
